nodes.title: Complete release-process follow-ups
nodes.body:
## Summary

- verify the wheel rebuilt from the generated sdist instead of comparing two checkout-built wheels
- normalize project URL labels and use HTTPS documentation metadata
- require direct-dependency lower-bound audits when adding Python feature releases
- record the need for a scheduled fresh dependency-resolution check

## Validation

- workflow YAML parses successfully
- `uv lock --check` passes
- direct and sdist-derived Python 3.14 wheels build and compare byte-for-byte equal
- `git diff --check` passes

nodes.title: Add Python 3.14 support
nodes.body:
## Summary

- Add Python 3.14 support
- Update dependency markers and migrate packaging to uv_build
- Modernize and expand CI and installed-artifact testing
- Repair tutorial sample-data retrieval
- Update and execute the maintained notebooks
- Add a Trusted Publishing release workflow
- Prepare version 0.5.15

## Validation

- 725 canonical tests pass locally
- Optional BGEN tests pass
- Tutorial and paper notebooks were executed and reviewed
- GitHub CI covers Python 3.10 through 3.14 across supported platforms
